highlights: Ignifire for Web now has a fully touch-optimized phone and tablet layout with safe-area-aware navigation.
The web player can be installed on iPhone and iPad from Safari and launches full screen from the Home Screen.
A new mobile now-playing screen provides large artwork, complete playback controls, seeking, volume, and swipe-down dismissal.
notes: Makes the web player an installable iOS-capable PWA and rebuilds its responsive navigation, library views, and playback experience for touch devices.
